resources.string: Modern libxposed API 102 template for rooted Vector and rootless LSPatch 1.2, with a movable Nyx-styled overlay and optional ShadowHook native scaffold.

%1$s

First configured target: %2$s

With Vector, enable this module for the configured target and restart the app.

With LSPatch, install the patched target with all its required splits.

When the overlay is enabled, tap the bubble in the target app to open the panel. Drag the header to move it.
